title: Assistant Handbag Designer – NYC
note: Asks for 1–3 years of handbag or accessories design experience and a related bachelor's degree.

facts.summary: Assistant designer supporting the design director and senior designers on seasonal handbag collections.
facts.duties: Make CAD drawings, tech sketches and renderings; keep spec sheets, color standards and trim libraries; manage samples with overseas factories; coordinate with tech design, production and merchandising.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's in fashion/accessories design or similar; 1–3 years experience; Illustrator, Photoshop, MS Office; knowledge of handbag construction and materials.
facts.apply: Apply through Steve Madden's ADP careers posting (also listed on FashionUnited, posted Oct 27, 2026).
